# Phase 9a arm: offline reach / mass / torque report (generated by scripts/arm_reach_report.py)

## Mass and centre of mass (robot standing, nominal stance)

| configuration | total mass (kg) | added (kg) | CoM x / y / z (mm) | CoM shift xy (mm) | CoM rise (mm) | 6-foot support margin (mm) | worst tripod margin (mm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| robot alone | 3.080 | 0.000 | +0.0 / +0.0 / -1.3 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 222 | 114 |
| + arm folded | 3.277 | 0.197 | +0.2 / +0.0 / +6.3 | 0.2 | 7.6 | 222 | 114 |
| + arm folded + 0.08 kg object | 3.357 | 0.277 | +3.2 / +0.0 / +9.1 | 3.2 | 10.4 | 221 | 112 |
| + arm ready (pre-grasp) | 3.277 | 0.197 | -10.5 / -0.0 / +5.0 | 10.5 | 6.3 | 219 | 105 |
| + arm at the most rearward grasp found (standing, 0.08 kg) | 3.357 | 0.277 | -22.7 / +0.0 / -0.2 | 22.7 | 1.1 | 206 | 95 |

RL domain randomisation the walking policy was trained with (`rl/envs/randomization.py`): payload 0.0-0.3 kg on the body at <= 20 mm xy offset (at body height: CoM height was never randomised), body mass x0.85-1.15. Arm 0.197 kg + object <= 0.08 kg = 0.277 kg.

## Static gravity torque (worst case with the max payload)

| joint | servo class | rated (N·m) | folded | ready | worst feasible grasp | use of rating |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| arm_shoulder | MG996R | 0.92 | 0.379 | 0.276 | 0.476 | 52 % |
| arm_elbow | MG92B | 0.34 | 0.202 | 0.195 | 0.257 | 76 % |
| arm_wrist_pitch | SG90 | 0.18 | 0.028 | 0.017 | 0.098 | 55 % |

(118 feasible grasp poses checked. Dynamic torques and the gripper squeeze are not included.)

## Where an object must be for a grasp (body frame, robot standing; object centre)

| object | size (m) | mass (kg) | strategy | feasible area (cm²) | x range at y=0 (m) | largest disc inside (radius cm, centre) | coverage of a 2 / 5 / 12 cm disc at that centre |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small_box | 0.050 x 0.050 x 0.050 | 0.05 | top | 204 | -0.32 .. -0.21 | 6.0, (-0.27, -0.02) | 100 % / 100 % / 45 % |
| mini_toolbox | 0.120 x 0.050 x 0.095 | 0.08 | top | 45 | -0.30 .. -0.26 | 3.0, (-0.28, +0.00) | 100 % / 51 % / 10 % |
| can | 0.066 x 0.066 x 0.120 | 0.06 | side | 257 | -0.39 .. -0.31 | 5.0, (-0.35, -0.04) | 100 % / 99 % / 45 % |
| mini_cone | 0.080 x 0.080 x 0.100 | 0.03 | side | 253 | -0.39 .. -0.31 | 5.0, (-0.35, -0.01) | 100 % / 99 % / 45 % |
| mini_extinguisher | 0.050 x 0.050 x 0.150 | 0.08 | side | 298 | -0.40 .. -0.31 | 5.1, (-0.35, -0.04) | 100 % / 100 % / 50 % |

Nav2 stops within 0.12 m (xy goal tolerance) and 0.2 rad: a 12 cm disc is NOT covered by any class, so a final approach (wrist camera + closed-loop relmotion, target error <= 2 cm) is required before every grasp.

## LiDAR

The yaw-servo base (0.04 x 0.03 m, z 0.030-0.055 m) crosses the lidar plane (z 0.05): it hides a rear sector of about +-11 deg (inside the footprint, so scan_self_filter turns it into 'no return'). Folded, every other arm part stays >= 41 mm above the plane.
